title: A break, looped and then chopped

params.note: The break is an original one-bar funk pattern on the 909 kit, not the Amen break or any other recorded break. The chop cuts it into sixteenth-note slices and plays them in a new order, ending in a snare roll made of one slice repeated.

caption: A break is a few bars where only the drums play, and looping and chopping are the two basic ways to use one once it is sampled. A loop keeps the drummer's phrasing intact: N.W.A looped the Amen break as it was played. A chop treats each hit as a separate sound to put in a new order, which is how jungle producers later rebuilt the same break. Switch between the two and watch the lights: when it is chopped, they jump around. The break here is an original pattern on a synthesized kit, not the Amen itself.
